notes.introduction: An exposition of Proverbs 19:27 on guarding against instruction that leads away from the words of knowledge, set against the backdrop of the modern information age and the proliferation of digital and AI-generated content. Supporting passages from Proverbs 1-2, Daniel 12, Acts 17, Romans 1, and Deuteronomy 13 frame the dangers of knowledge divorced from the fear of God.
